name: cuddlynest-search
description: Search CuddlyNest hotels and get listing details including room prices and availability
long_description: An MCP server for searching CuddlyNest hotels and retrieving listing details. Static basics (name, location, description, amenities, images) are read from the listing page's structured data; room options, prices, availability and cancellation policies are read from the public listing page rendered in a headless browser (Playwright/Chromium) — the same content any visitor sees, with no access to internal APIs or auth tokens. Read-only: search and listing details only, no booking or payment. Respects robots.txt by default with an option to override for testing.

tools.name: cuddlynest_search
tools.description: Resolve a destination on CuddlyNest to its candidates (name, location, coordinates, property count) via the public autosuggestion API.

tools.name: cuddlynest_listing_details
tools.description: Get details for a specific CuddlyNest hotel: static basics plus room options, prices, availability and cancellation policies read from the public listing page.

ignore_robots_txt.title: Ignore robots.txt
ignore_robots_txt.description: Bypass robots.txt restrictions when fetching CuddlyNest listing pages. Use with caution and respect CuddlyNest's terms of service.

scrape_timeout_ms.title: Listing scrape timeout (ms)
scrape_timeout_ms.description: Max time to wait for the listing page's rooms/prices to render in the headless browser. Default 35000.
